mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.title, t.completed, t.display_order, t.category_id, c.name AS category_name, c.color AS category_color FROM todos t LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id ORDER BY t.display_order, t.id
SELECT t.id, t.title, t.completed, t.display_order, t.category_id, c.name AS category_name, c.color AS category_color FROM todos t LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id WHERE t.id = #{id}
SELECT id, title, completed, display_order FROM todos ORDER BY display_order, id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todos (title, completed, display_order, category_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{completed}, #{displayOrder}, #{categoryId})
